title: video-freeze-wt: clip selection has no canvas or Layers representation
notes: Checklist sweep gate 4 fail: canvas ring exists only for the arrow (#arrowRing); the clip selected in steps 2-6 has no canvas representation, and #lrRec/#lrStill/#lrArrow are only shown/hidden, never given .sel. Gate 10 warn: clip inspector shows In/Out/Time/Stroke with no animatable-property rows at all; dead keyframe CSS (~38-44) has no consuming markup. Shared root cause: steps pass only a .clip id to data-select and walkthrough.js strips .sel from every .lrow, so Layers never mirrors the selection. Also D9 warn: no data-tl-summary, so the collapsed timeline row names nothing; play button lacks aria-pressed. From sweep-every-clickthrough-page-for-checklist-conf.
